hero.title: Protecting your property with
hero.lead: A family-owned and operated roofing company serving the Houston area, from minor repairs to complete commercial roof installations. Free roof inspections, free estimates, financing and 24/7 emergency service.
hero.imageAlt: A home with a new grey architectural shingle roof and stone gables

services.title: Residential Roofing
services.short: Roofing for Houston-area homes, from repairs to replacement.
services.text: Your home deserves protection from a roofing team that understands the unique challenges Houston's climate presents.
services.imageAlt: A drone view of a waterfront home with a new brown shingle roof
body: Take care of those you love by protecting what shields them the most. Our residential roofing services ensure your family stays safe and your home looks its best. Based in Houston, TX, our team is dedicated to providing you with the highest level of craftsmanship and care.

Our residential roofing services encompass everything from traditional asphalt shingles to energy-efficient cool roofing systems designed specifically for Texas heat. A well-maintained roof is essential for the safety and aesthetics of your home, and it keeps your curb appeal while it stands up to the elements.
points: Financing options to fit your budget
No job is too big or too small

services.title: Roof Installation
services.short: Asphalt, metal and tile roofs installed to manufacturer spec.
services.text: Specializing in asphalt, metal and tile roof installations, we make sure every roof we install stands the test of time.
services.imageAlt: New shingles being laid over the exposed timber framing of a roof
body: Can you count on the roof over your head? With TCB Elite Fleet, you can. Professional roof installation is about more than just placing new materials. It is a comprehensive process that begins with thorough preparation and ends with meticulous quality checks, and our installation teams follow manufacturer-specified protocols so your new roof performs for its entire expected lifespan.

Your roof is your home's first line of defense, and getting it installed correctly is what protects your investment and your property's value. Our commitment is to give you a durable, dependable roof that offers peace of mind for years to come.
points: Expertise in asphalt, metal and tile roofs
Tailored solutions to fit your specific needs
Free roof inspections and free estimates

faqs.q: How long does it take to replace a roof?
faqs.a: This will vary depending on the size of the roof, but we can typically have the job completed in just one day.

services.title: Roof Repair
services.short: Leaks and damage put right before they become emergencies.
services.text: Timely roof repairs can prevent minor issues from escalating into costly emergencies, and many of our repairs are one-day jobs.
services.imageAlt: A hammer and pulled roofing nails resting on a shingle roof
body: Are you stressed about roof damage? Our repair specialists are trained to quickly identify the root causes of leaks, damaged areas or performance issues affecting your roof. We provide honest assessments and straightforward solutions rather than pushing for unnecessary replacements.

We handle everything, from working with your insurance claim representative to offering financing options, so you get the quality service you deserve at a reasonable rate. Many of our roof repairs are one-day jobs.
points: Ensure the safety of your family
We work with your insurance claim representative

faqs.a: Yes, we offer complimentary roof inspections. If we find any concerns, we will take photos and show them to you. If the damage is significant enough that insurance will cover it, we will let you know so that you can file a claim.

services.title: Storm-Damaged Roof Repair
services.text: Our crews mobilize quickly after major storms, prioritizing temporary protection before completing permanent repairs.
services.imageAlt: A tree fallen against the roof of a house after a storm
body: When your roof has taken a hit from a storm, peace of mind can seem out of reach. That is where TCB Elite Fleet comes in. We are dedicated to making your roof look brand new, no matter the damage, and our team offers 24/7 emergency repairs, so you are never left waiting.

Our experienced crews can quickly mobilize after major storms, prioritizing temporary protection measures before completing permanent repairs that restore your roof's structural integrity and weather resistance. Storms are unpredictable, and acting quickly prevents further issues and saves you money in the long run.
points: Temporary protection first, permanent repair after
Maintains the structural integrity of your home
Free roof inspection after the storm

faqs.q: How often does my roof need to be inspected?
faqs.a: A good rule of thumb is to have your roof inspected once a year, but if there is a storm with high winds, we recommend having it looked at as soon as possible.

services.title: Hail-Damaged Roof Repair
services.short: Granule loss, dents and cracked tiles put right.
services.text: From granule loss on asphalt shingles to dents in metal roofing or cracked tiles, we address all forms of hail damage.
services.imageAlt: A hand holding a hailstone above a shingle roof
body: Hail damage is a serious concern for homeowners, but you do not have to tackle it alone. We are here to make storm recovery straightforward and stress-free: we assess your roof damage and provide a tailored solution that suits your needs.

Hail can cause significant damage to your roof, leading to leaks, structural issues and further costly repairs if left unchecked. Severe hail damage can compromise roof integrity, so the sooner it is found, the less it costs to put right.
points: Free roof inspection with photos of what we find

services.title: Commercial Roofing
services.short: Flat and low-slope systems: TPO, modified bitumen and more.
services.text: Flat roofing systems, TPO, modified bitumen and other commercial-grade materials designed to protect your business investment.
body: Commercial properties require specialized roofing approaches that balance durability, maintenance requirements and cost-effectiveness. Our commercial roofing team brings extensive experience with flat roofing systems, TPO, modified bitumen and other commercial-grade materials.

As a business owner, you have got a million things on your mind. Let us handle your roofing needs so you can concentrate on what matters most, running your business. A well-maintained roof ensures the safety of your building, your employees and your clients.
points: Enhanced energy efficiency and long-term cost savings

about.title: Mont Belvieu's preferred roofing contractor
text: We understand that your roof isn't just another component of your property—it's your first line of defense against weather extremes, a significant investment, and a crucial factor in your building's energy efficiency. That's why our team approaches every project with meticulous attention to detail, using only premium materials and proven installation methods.

What truly sets TCB Elite Fleet apart is our unwavering commitment to customer satisfaction and transparent business practices. Our A+ rating with the Better Business Bureau reflects our dedication to excellence in every interaction. We believe in establishing clear communication from the initial free inspection through project completion, ensuring you're informed and comfortable throughout the entire process.
Call to ask about our warranties and insurance claims process. We also offer free estimates, which means you don't have to pay upfront. Many of our roof repairs are one-day jobs.

facts.heading: Why Choose TCB Elite Fleet
items: No job is too big or too small

facts.heading: Financing
facts.text: We believe every homeowner deserves a strong, reliable roof without financial stress. We offer a range of financing options tailored to your needs, with personalized rates designed to fit your budget. Whether it is a small repair or a full roof replacement, you can protect your home today and pay over time. Financing options are available to help ease the burden of your roofing project and make it more affordable.

facts.heading: Gutters and Sheetrock
facts.text: From gutters to sheetrock, TCB Elite Fleet is here for your roof. We can handle a variety of jobs, regardless of your roofing materials, and no service request is ever too big or small.
